The checklist a token goes through when it is launched, and the reverse pass
when one is withdrawn — which is why this leaf declares both add-token and
retire-token. Draft AND long past its volatile limit, so it carries both
demotions at once and each must be reported with its own reason rather than
one absorbing the other.
